title: "Add event" button disappears if "KOrganizer View" is above "KOrganizer" in file associations
line: The Digital Clock's "Add…" button and middle-click now open KOrganizer even when the hidden "KOrganizer View" helper is ranked above it.
explanation: ApplicationIntegration only looked at the single preferred text/calendar handler. When that is KOrganizer's hidden "KOrganizer View" helper (NoDisplay, Exec=korganizer --view %u), the clock either rejected it because it didn't list text/calendar itself, so no calendar app was found and the "Add…" button disappeared, or accepted it and launched the helper without a file. The change (same as Niccolò's open MR !7320) queries all text/calendar handlers in preference order and takes the first that lists text/calendar itself and is not NoDisplay.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: Skip NoDisplay helpers when picking the calendar app

Only the preferred text/calendar handler was considered, so a hidden helper
like "KOrganizer View" on top either hid the "Add…" button or got launched
without a file. Use the most preferred suitable handler that isn't NoDisplay.

BUG: 507161

Same setup with the fix: "Add…" is back and opens KOrganizer
Master, helper listing text/calendar itself and ranked first: the clock offers "KOrganizer View" (and "Add…" launched the helper)

review.text: Same change as the existing MR !7320: take the first non-NoDisplay handler that lists text/calendar itself, in preference order, instead of only the single preferred one. Minimal and correct, both scenarios shown in before/after. Keep BUG: 523596 if this commit replaces the MR's.
